reason: the security lens's findings only the code can fix

findings.text: security lens, medium: The holder string extracted from a GitHub issue comment by _ccgl_read_holder is passed to error(), which uses `echo -e "… $*"`, so backslash sequences (\n, \033[…) in the holder are interpreted by echo, allowing a crafted run-status comment to inject fake log lines or terminal control sequences into the operator's stderr. (core/pipeline/runner.sh: "error "issue ${_runner_issue:-} is already claimed: ${_ZBUILD_CLAIM_HOLDER:-unknown}""; happens when: A GitHub issue comment whose <!-- zbuild-holder: --> field contains backslash escape sequences such as \n or \033[31m; this comment is fetched by _ccgl_read_holder via `gh issue comment list` and its content stored in _ZBUILD_CLAIM_HOLDER before the error() call.; fix: code)
